---
title: errors
---

A Lua syntax error (left as written):

```{lmd}
local x = 1
return {= a =} +
```

A markdown error inside a fragment (left as written):

```{lmd}
return {=: This line mentions the groups' Unique IDs. :=}
```

An unsupported node inside a fragment (left as written):

```{lmd}
return {=:
| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |
:=}
```

A runtime error, displayed:

```{lmd}
local x = 1
error("boom")
```

Wrong shapes, displayed:

```{lmd}
return {=[ inlines are not blocks ]=}
```

An inline runtime error `{lmd} nope()` and a wrong shape `{lmd} pandoc.Para({})` here.

> ```{lmd}
> local x = 1
> error("quoted")
> ```

Invalid cell options:

```{lmd}
--| echo: [
return nil
```

After everything.
